description: The side menu of a dashboard: logo, menu groups, user account, and a button to fold it away. 240px wide with a dark green background; the active item uses the brand color. On phones the menu opens as a Sheet.
structure: Page structure: SidebarProvider wraps Sidebar (the menu) and SidebarInset (the page content). SidebarTrigger in the header opens/closes the menu, and so does Ctrl+B (⌘B on Mac).
colors: The sidebar colors come from the --sidebar-* tokens in semantic.css. Change those tokens for another look (e.g. a light sidebar) without touching the component.
hook: useSidebar() reads and changes the menu state from any component inside SidebarProvider.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: sidebar is attached to the screen edge, floating is a rounded box, and inset turns the page content into a card next to the menu.

loading.title: Loading
loading.description: SidebarMenuSkeleton stands in for items while the menu loads. collapsible="none" keeps the menu always open.

parts.provider: Keeps the open/folded state. Wraps the menu and the page content.
parts.sidebar: The menu itself. Becomes a Sheet on phones.
parts.trigger: Button that opens/closes the menu, usually in the page header.
parts.rail: Thin strip on the menu edge; click to fold/unfold.
parts.inset: The page content next to the menu (main element).
parts.header: Top part: logo or unit switcher.
parts.content: Scrolling middle part with the menu groups.
parts.group: Menu group with a label and an optional action.
parts.menuButton: Menu button or link. Supports isActive, tooltip and asChild.
parts.menuExtras: Extras on the right of an item: a small action button or a number (badge).

props.side: Side of the screen the menu is on.
props.variant: Frame style: attached, floating, or inset.
props.collapsible: When closed: slides off screen, folds to icons, or cannot close.
props.isActive: Marks the page that is open.
props.tooltip: Label shown on hover while the menu is folded to icons.
